name: Ribeirao Preto

queries.query: Ribeirão Preto cadastro imobiliário mapa lotes parcelas geoprocessamento oficial prefeitura
queries.scope: Find current official municipal lot map and safe full-geometry route.
queries.result: Official city pages describe a free Geoportal with property location and current “base imobiliária” lot division. The public ArcGIS MapServer exposes a Lote polygon layer. An exact WUP-point query returned one full polygon with only gid (system OID) requested; no cadastral, address, or IPTU fields were requested.

queries.query: Ribeirao Preto official municipal geoportal cadastro urbano lot parcel GIS map service
queries.scope: Confirm that the city owns the current parcel map and discover service geometry schema.
queries.result: The Prefeitura department page confirms a current municipal lot-division base in the Geoportal; the viewer item data binds the Cadastro Urbano map to the municipal MapServer layer Lote.

officialSources.observation: City news calls the Geoportal free/public and says it shows property, block/lot and cadastro urbano.
Planning Department says the current lot-division base is available in Geoportal; warns maps are preliminary and may not reflect later amalgamations/subdivisions.

serviceChecks.observation: Three public results; municipal Cadastro Urbano Web Map item d0dc6fc2453a46998d8f55995e4ac4b0 is the map consumed by the application.
Municipal service lists layer 0 Lote and layer 7 Quadra plus thematic layers.
Lote is esriGeometryPolygon, EPSG:31983; schema has gid OID and other cadastral/address fields. Query selected gid only.

serviceChecks.method: GET exact WUP point; outFields=gid; returnGeometry=true; outSR=4326; f=geojson
serviceChecks.observation: One full Polygon returned, gid only; the locator is inside the polygon.

freshResearch.geometryDecision: One full official municipal Lote polygon retained with only its system OID and geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal “base imobiliária atual (divisão de lotes)” and Geoportal Cadastro Urbano layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Exact WUP point intersects one complete Lote polygon (gid 179088); Turf point-in-polygon passed. The municipal department describes it as a current lot-division reference base but explicitly warns it is preliminary and not equivalent to recorded plans or post-approval changes.

technicalBlocker: All 729 qualified native GIS rows are valid, but the bounded set has 12,462 exact duplicate geometry pairs and 12,467 overlap pairs above 0.01 m². Distinct native IDs 178927 and 178928 freshly return identical full footprints of 2,636.51 m² in EPSG:31983. No documented ground-only or unit filter clears these stacked footprints; no rows were excluded or repaired.
remainingUncertainty: How this tax/urban-mapping lot layer aligns with registered title boundaries, update date/coverage throughout city, and whether its native OID is stable across revisions.
nextStep: Parent may qualify this anonymous GIS layer; keep legal/title-boundary semantics separate from the city’s preliminary lot-map disclaimer.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Municipal Geoportal and Planning Department pages describe the lot division base and urban cadastral map; official city service states the current base is preliminary and not a substitute for recorded plans.
